event_chain.summary: Phishing emails impersonating SCDE/ClassWallet sent to program vendors

summary: In late September 2026 attackers sent phishing emails impersonating the South Carolina Department of Education or the ClassWallet payment platform to service providers (vendors) in South Carolina's Education Scholarship Trust Fund program, trying to harvest their banking and account information. Some vendors' banking details were obtained. The department notified vendors on September 25, told them to reset email and ClassWallet passwords, and with ClassWallet temporarily locked down the system, halting vendor payments while it assessed which bank account details were affected.
